text:
For noise cancelling under $200, the **JBL Live 780NC** has the strongest ANC, and the **Anker Soundcore Space Q45** is the best value. I only have a direct store link for one pair, the Soundcore Space One Pro. For the others I've linked the review pages, which list retailers and current prices.

**Top picks**

- **Best ANC: JBL Live 780NC.** RTINGS ranks it #1 under $200. Its ANC competes with Sony and Bose flagships, and battery life is about 60 hours. It also supports multipoint, LDAC and LC3. The downsides are high clamping force and mediocre headband padding, so it may be tiring on larger heads. RTINGS says it sometimes sells just under $200. [RTINGS review and prices](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)
- **Best value: Anker Soundcore Space Q45.** It costs around $100 and has excellent noise isolation, with about 28 hours of battery. RTINGS notes some ANC hiss and reports of headband or hinge breakage. [RTINGS review and prices](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- **Best sound: Sennheiser Accentum Plus.** It has a smooth, bassy sound, a parametric EQ and 56 hours of battery. Its ANC is weaker than the others, and the headband is unpadded. [RTINGS review and prices](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/by-price/under-200)
- **Best for calls: Sony ULT WEAR.** It has strong ANC, though slightly less bass-rumble reduction than the JBL. SoundGuys (via RatingMobile) lists it at $200, with LDAC, multipoint and the strongest low-frequency cancelling of its four picks. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)
- **Best for battery: Soundcore Space One Pro.** Tom's Guide names it best under $200. It lasts 40 hours with ANC on and has LDAC and a fold-flat design. It lists at $199.99, and a code (AFSC20) takes $39.99 off, for about $160 at Soundcore's US store. Dealectric tested the code on Oct 22. It expires 12/31/2026 and doesn't apply to items already on sale. [Buy at Soundcore](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one-pro). This is an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission at no cost to you.

**Cheaper option**

- **JLab JBuds Lux ANC (~$80):** It has up to 44 hours of battery. SoundGuys measured its ANC as the weakest of its four picks, but it's enough to take the edge off a bus or office. [Details](https://ratingmobile.com/articles/en/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

**Skip for now:** The Sony WH-CH730N (about $176–178) sounds and performs well, but Tom's Guide calls the US price too high for what you get. [Review](https://www.tomsguide.com/audio/headphones/sony-wh-ch730n-review)

Prices change often, so check the current price before buying. If you tell me whether you use an iPhone or Android, how you'll use them (flights, office, calls), and how much comfort matters, I can narrow this to one pick.
